summary: Source producer/consumer closure repair for #5273, pending exact-candidate CI and native adoption. Retain the preceding versioned annotation, cumulative confidence-preserving execution and revision-bound classification contract. The initial source introduced LEARN migration prepare/v3 but left recovery readback at v1 and the maintained Python native-result consumer accepting only scope/v1-v2 plus Work level. That breaks the actual installed qualification/readback path despite local typed migration success. Both native report producers now emit LEARN prepare/readback v3, and board_v2_native_results.py accepts only the closed LEARN field/assignment/value shapes, exact Project 3 and selected issue identities, fixed native field/options, owning evidence URLs and original typed change/preimage tokens. Prior v1/v2 remain supported; unknown properties, unsupported unions/versions, selected identity drift and changed preimages refuse. An actual CLI prepare/apply/readback fixture is consumed by the maintained Python decoder and complete reported field-transition verifier, with causal malformed-report controls. Original CI separately identified misplaced implementation XML docs and a stale conditional writer census identity; the source repair preserves canonical signature docs and audits/rebinds the existing comment/telemetry sink rather than weakening those gates. No new writer, native effect, publication, enrollment or timer is established by the repair. Lesson: schema changes require both producers and every maintained consumer, exercised on actual generated bytes, before native qualification can be claimed.
title: Additive LEARN card annotations and revision-bound evidence
